explanation:
A mutex lock is a synchronization mechanism in C programming that ensures only one thread can access a shared resource at a time. It is used to prevent race conditions in multithreaded applications, maintaining data integrity and avoiding conflicts when multiple threads attempt to modify the same data simultaneously.

A mutex lock is a synchronization primitive in C programming, commonly used with libraries like pthreads in multithreaded applications. It ensures that only one thread can access a shared resource or critical section at a time, preventing race conditions and maintaining data integrity by serializing access.
